Dentist Suspended for Mocking Murder Victim's Death on Social Media

A dentist from Madhya Pradesh, Dr. Muskan Soni, has been suspended for five years by the All India Dental Association (AIDSA) after posting an Instagram video that appeared to mock the murder of Pune realtor Ketan Agarwal. The association cited her remarks as offensive and a violation of ethical standards, leading to widespread backlash and her suspension from all posts. Dr. Soni has since apologized for her words.
